considered.cj_name: A4 Thermal Portable Mini Office Bluetooth Printer
considered.reason: Chosen. Generic inkless A4 portable thermal printer, Bluetooth, 264 x 78 x 42 mm, 2600 mAh built-in battery, prints documents/photos, ships with paper roll(s) and charging cord; same function and pocket form as the RONGTA F11B. App ecosystem and label-media support not stated.

considered.cj_name: MT610 Bluetooth Wireless A4 Portable Thermal Printer For Home And Office Documents
considered.reason: Same function and similar size (265 x 55 x 47 mm), but it is the HPRT-branded MT610 (Chinese title names the brand), mixed with paper-only variants; a different brand's own model rather than a generic equivalent.

match.cj_name: A4 Thermal Portable Mini Office Bluetooth Printer
match.note: Inkless Bluetooth A4 pocket thermal printer with built-in battery and paper rolls, matching the RONGTA F11B's function and form. Variants differ by included paper (1 roll, 3 rolls, 3 rolls + case); brand app ecosystem not comparable.
